author: haitang000
message:
feat: put idle background tabs to sleep

Port Zigzag TabSleep: a hidden page sleeps after an hour unseen, after 15 minutes when more than 20 are awake, and after 5 minutes while memory is short. Favorites wait for critical memory; pages on screen, playing sound, loading or part of a split never sleep. WebView2 suspends with TrySuspend and resumes on show, two suspensions in flight at a time; Settings > General > Tabs can turn it off, which wakes everything.

Sleeping tabs get Zigzag's dashed ring, a tooltip and the hover card's reason. Ported from Zigzag Tabs/TabSleep.swift (Apache-2.0); mapping and platform differences are in docs/TAB_SLEEP_PORT.md.

author: haitang000
message:
fix: keep cached site icons sharp at their own resolution

WebView2's favicon store only holds 16 and 32 pixel bitmaps, but the cache
stretched every icon to 64 pixels through image::thumbnail, so a 16px icon
was stored as an interpolated blur and the sidebar looked soft at every DPI,
especially at 200% scaling. Small icons now keep their own size and only
larger ones are shrunk.

Pages that declare an SVG or a 64px+ icon get it fetched at its own
resolution in the background (Zigzag's ranking and fallbacks over WinHTTP),
so tab and favorite icons stay sharp where WebView2's bitmap is too small.
Quality never regresses: a smaller capture cannot replace a sharper icon,
cross-site navigation drops the previous site's icon, and saved icons are
only replaced by a sharper one or by a front page's own declaration.

Sessions written by older builds get their blurred icons fetched again
once (iconVersion marker, written only when the refresh found real icons so
an offline launch retries). Adds test:native:favicons and updates the
validation record.

author: haitang000
message:
feat: restore each space's last tab when switching back

Switching spaces always landed on the target space's first tab, so returning
to a space lost the page the user had been reading. Each Space now remembers
the tab it was showing when the user left it (persisted with the session) and
switching back restores it, including a shared favorite opened there. When the
remembered tab no longer exists or was moved to another space, the space's
most recently shown tab is restored instead; a blank page is created only when
the space has no tabs left. Deleting the current space lands on the remaining
space's remembered tab the same way. The standalone preview mirrors this, and
the new session field is optional so older sessions load unchanged.

Tests: Rust model tests for restore, fallback and shared-favorite cases;
tab-style unit tests for the preview reducer; a Playwright spaces case; and
native WebView2 smoke assertions that both switch directions land on the page
each space was showing. The browser E2E spec now selects the pinned page it
splits explicitly instead of relying on the old first-tab behavior.

author: haitang000
message:
feat: port Zigzag's downloads panel and download history

Downloads are now tracked as rows instead of being saved silently. The host wraps ICoreWebView2DownloadOperation into a DownloadItem state machine (inProgress/paused/finished/failed/cancelled) with received/total bytes, filename collision handling already in the folder redirect, interrupt reasons in plain words, progress ticks coalesced to ~8 fps, and Pause/Resume/Cancel/Open/Reveal actions. The list is capped at 50 rows, persisted in a new SQLite downloads table, restored on launch (a download that was running at quit becomes an interruption, since WebView2 keeps no resume data across processes), and saved again on quit.

The UI is Zigzag's DownloadsPanel adapted to the sidebar lane: a footer button with an active-count badge, Ctrl+J, the command bar and a download landing all reveal the panel; rows show the progress line, pause/resume and cancel while active, reveal when finished, remove for interrupted rows, a Clear that never discards a running or paused file, an empty state, and Open Downloads Folder. The panel closes on Esc, the same button, or a click elsewhere in the shell, and expands a collapsed sidebar rather than opening out of sight. The standalone preview mirrors the list and row actions.

Tests: Rust unit tests for the list/clear/pause state machine, interrupt wording and SQLite roundtrip; tab-style unit tests for byte formatting and status lines; Playwright coverage for the panel, pause/resume/cancel, Clear and the keyboard routes; and scripts/native-downloads-smoke.mjs against real WebView2 (auto-reveal, folder destination, collision naming, pause byte stability, resume, cancel without leftovers, Clear, shell/page keyboard, and history across a restart). Existing native settings download-folder smoke, find/site-controls/clear-menu smokes and the full E2E suite (86/86) still pass.

author: haitang000
message:
test: wait for created tabs in the native clear-menu smoke

The smoke opened three tabs with fixed sleeps; under load a tab command can land late, so the row-count assertion sometimes observed an intermediate state. Wait for each URL to appear in the published state before issuing the next command, then wait for the row count to reach the expected total before asserting.

author: haitang000
message:
feat: show the sidebar scrollbar only while the tab list scrolls

Replace the stock thin scrollbar with Chromium's ambient pill styling: the thumb is transparent at rest and paints only while .space-list has the scrolling state, then fades 900ms after the last scroll event. The thumb uses a padding-box background with asymmetric borders so it hangs away from the header, keeps a 36px minimum length, and follows the ink token in both themes.

Restoring a pane's saved scroll position on mount no longer flashes the bar: onScroll ignores scroll events until the first animation frame, and the timer is cleared on unmount. Covered by tests/e2e/sidebar-scroll.spec.ts for a synthetic scroll event and a real wheel over a long tab list.

author: haitang000
message:
feat: turn Clear into Undo for the undo window

After a clearable batch closes (Clear, Close Others, Close Below) the Clear slot in the Tabs label now becomes a visible Undo pill for the same four seconds the host keeps the batch, instead of only offering Undo in the bottom toast. Clicking it restores the batch; hovering it does not arm or preview a new clear; when the window lapses the slot returns to Clear without arming until the pointer re-enters. The undo window is derived from the host's undoBatch toast and lives independently in the store so an unrelated hint toast cannot shorten it.

The standalone preview now keeps a real restoreBatch batch and reducer path, so Undo works there too (original indexes, previous active tab, dropping the blank tab a clear-all auto-created). Tests: a native smoke check clicks the sidebar Undo after Clear and verifies restoration, plus a four-second expiry check where the host still accepts the batch through IPC; the Playwright Clear test exercises the Undo slot end to end.

author: haitang000
message:
feat: port Zigzag clear ladder, tab aging and the complete tab menu

Tab aging: Tab gains a persisted lastActivated timestamp (repaired to fresh for older sessions and refreshed on activation/new/restore), and sidebar rows ease from full ink to Zigzag's 0.42 floor between six hours and four days, snapping back for the selected or hovered row. A minute clock in the store keeps the fade current.

Clear: the Tabs label now shows Zigzag's Clear / Clear Old button on hover, arming for 350ms so a stray click cannot wipe the list. Hovering the button sinks the rows it would close to 18%. The Rust model owns the three-step ladder (faded tabs first, never tabs playing sound; otherwise the other tabs; last the current tab and its split partner), mirrored read-only in the sidebar for the label and preview. Clear, Close Others and Close Below all close as one undoable batch: the host remembers original indexes and the previous active tab, emits an action toast with Undo, and restores the batch exactly, removing the blank tab that closing everything auto-created and de-duplicating the closed stack.

Tab menu completion: customTitle rename with a restore-page-title action (shown in the sidebar, Desk, hover preview and command-bar tab results), Copy Link through a new Win32 clipboard host command, Duplicate Tab, explicit Close Others/Below with counts that target the right-clicked background tab instead of the active one, and a tab-name heading in the menu. The menu now clamps its own height to the viewport so the longer list scrolls.

UI: a bottom ActionToast (160ms rise in, 120ms drop out) joins the popup-layer surfaces with shadow bleed and focus-safe Undo; the preview reducer mirrors rename/duplicate/clear for the standalone UI, and command.ts shares the base-tab logic. Tests: Rust model tests for the clear ladder, aging repair, rename/duplicate/explicit close targets; tab-meta unit tests; Playwright coverage for the menu, Clear arming/preview and toast; and scripts/native-clear-menu-smoke.mjs exercising rename, duplicate, clipboard, Close Others/Below undo, both Clear steps, tab-name restart persistence against real WebView2.

revert: restore the stock Inno Setup installer wizard

Remove the custom Rove-styled installer UI introduced for beta4: Design.iss, Button.iss, the bundled Outfit font and its license are gone, and Rove.iss no longer includes the custom design code. The stock Inno Setup modern wizard is used again, with Inno's standard messages for the desktop shortcut and post-install launch.

author: haitang000
message:
feat: drop in and slide out the zoom percentage capsule

Give the zoom Toast the entrance and exit motion Zigzag's floating surfaces have: the capsule inside .status-toast drops down from above (translateY(-10px) to 0, 160ms, ease-out) with a fade, and on the way out slides back up (0 to translateY(-10px), 120ms) before unmounting. The outer .status-toast keeps the layout box, so the native popup region reported by PopupRoot stays put while the capsule animates and the existing 20px shadow bleed covers the travel.

Vue's explicit Transition duration unmounts the wrapper after the 120ms exit; Reduce Motion falls back to the app-wide instant/80ms convention. Tests: a Playwright test records animationstart for zoom-toast-drop-in/fade-in and zoom-toast-slide-out; the native site-controls smoke now also verifies the drop-in and slide-out in the real popup WebView2 and that the capsule auto-hides after 1.2s.

author: haitang000
message:
feat: port Zigzag per-site zoom, mute, audio indicator and swipe navigation

Zoom: Zigzag's zoomSteps ladder [0.5...3.0] from BrowserActions.swift, ZoomLevels-style persistence keyed by normalized host (www stripped) in the session JSON, and the visible-percentage Toast. Ctrl+= / Ctrl+Shift+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0 work from both the page accelerator and the trusted UI, with command-bar actions and a zoom row in the active tab's context menu; the host applies a site's stored zoom whenever a page loads and remembers zoom changed by WebView2's own Ctrl+wheel/pinch through ZoomFactorChanged.

Mute and playing indicator: new native/src/site.rs wraps WebView2's SetIsMuted / IsDocumentPlayingAudio; Tab gains a persisted muted flag, the tab row shows Zigzag's speaker while a page plays sound or is muted and clicking it toggles mute, and the tab context menu plus command bar expose mute/unmute. Audio changes are forwarded as runtime events and pruned when tabs close.

Swipe: page WebViews opt into WebView2's own two-finger back/forward swipe (with_back_forward_navigation_gestures), which performs the gesture and its animation natively; the precision-touchpad path itself is left for a manual check.

Tests: Rust unit tests for site keys, the zoom ladder, session repair and legacy sessions; a context-action unit test; Playwright coverage for the tab menu, speaker state, zoom events and command bar actions (plus a timing fix for the find-bar counter assertion); and scripts/native-site-controls-smoke.mjs covering 100/110/125/150%, per-site isolation, mute state, real WebView2 audio playing detection, internal-page no-ops and restart persistence. Real keyboard Ctrl+=/Ctrl+Shift+=/Ctrl+-/Ctrl+0 were verified against the running native window.

author: haitang000
message:
feat: port Zigzag find-in-page bar with motion

Merge the find-in-page code from feat/find-in-page onto main, without the research/documentation changes: README, docs/SOURCE_ANALYSIS.md, docs/VALIDATION.md and docs/PORT_CANDIDATES.md stay on the feature branch. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is kept because it records the Apache-2.0 attribution for the ported Zigzag behavior.

The change ports Window/FindBar.swift onto WebView2's ICoreWebView2Find (native/src/find.rs plus host findOpen/findStart/findNext/findClose and session lifetime, Ctrl+F accelerator, focus/Esc handling), adds FindBar.vue in the trusted floating layer with match counter, stepping and toggles, and includes the follow-up fixes: the popup layer widens its native clip region around the bar so the drop shadow is no longer cut into a square halo (src/lib/popup-layer.ts), and the bar animates in/out (160ms/120ms, 80ms fade under Reduce Motion) with an inner surface so the native region never resizes mid-animation. Includes unit tests, Playwright find/animation tests and the native find smoke (with a Win32 region probe).
